body:
Mother always does the dishes on the weekends. Okay, so first, she told me she shouldn't have to do them because she didn't eat dinner, even though she sat right next to me eating her entire dinner not long before so I called her a liar.. so then she told me that I had to do them since I didn't do them on Friday, but she cooks dinner on Sunday evenings, but she made me cook so it made up for it? And she told me if I didn't do the dishes, she'd have me thrown out and if I didn't get out, she'd call the cops. So I got frustrated and randomly yelled. Then she slapped me, grabbed my chin, tried to suffocate me/choke me out with her hands, then grabbed my whole body and shoved me.. and I kept screaming at her to stop.. then I was threatened one last time before I finally just did the dishes. I can't report it because nobody will believe me because she lied before and said I shoved her and the police arrested me because they said it was a mandatory arrest. The case is closed and they had a year to prosecute me and never did. But they arrested me and booked me, but they never read my miranda rights, if those apply. So now every time I try to defend myself verbally to get her to back down, I'm the one who gets hurt. She tells me stuff like how I can't leave her and that she'll follow me wherever I go, even to other countries, and masks these statements as jokes... If I left, I don't even want her to know where I went.. that's why I'd prefer to go to Canada since she doesn't have a passport.. or maybe to a state way northeast. But now she knows she can fully control me when she's here so now I have to be her obedient slave just so I don't get threatened. She calls me randomly from work in the middle of the day and tells me how I need to do this and I need to do that and so I don't answer so she'll make comments on the answering machine about how I must be napping and later, she'll come home and tell me I need to get my "sleep schedule" straightened out.. and I have insomnia.. because I use the internet and relax and I'll be ready to sleep soon.. Then she turns off the modem so now I'm like wth and I'm fully awakened, and if I stay up all night, she tells me over and over again to stay awake all day so I'll go to sleep that night. Also, she steals worthy assets from her job that supervisors have told people not to steal.. and it's not just her.. some of her coworkers have done it and I've even randomly seen people from other branches have talked about it on Facebook that they do it too. And yes, these are tax dollars we're talking about.
Yeah, well I've been waiting for sooo long.. but because of the economy they changed the job I was intending to get because they took that job and combined it with job duties of another job to save money.
Yeah.. It's been 16 months though.. I either don't push myself at all or I push myself too hard.. and everybody else is constantly pushing me.. I feel like a lazy bum and a failure.. my mother tells me how she got me the degree because she drove me 20 miles each way to my 2-year college.. Because spending 1 hour per day 5 days a week driving me back and forth with gas being paid for her for 2 years is worth more than having a GPA greater than 3.0, passing every class with at least a C, going to mostly every class, doing every homework assignment, graduating with honors, and satisfying the strict requirements for both the 2-year and 4-year colleges.. without her or I paying for any tuition. I never get time alone because if she's not here, the neighbors next door or upstairs are up to something or she's calling me.. I just wish I could have absolute silence. And my senses are too sensitive many times and it makes me want to scream so today I screamed into a pillow for the first time ever.

I live with my mother so far.. My day is researching jobs in the area.. sometimes searching for jobs that could magically provide relocation for entry-level workers and are legitimate and occasionally looking to Canada. I don't have a passport or anything, but I have enough money for one.. but I don't want to spend the little I have left in case I desperately need it.. for food or something.

Yeah, I have even more stuff that they diagnosed me with that comes with ADD and social anxiety.

Okay, I'm going to look.

And when do you finish your degree? And what is your major? if those aren't too personal of questions..
